(r, n - s) of signature_der_plain re-encoded as DER: verification MUST accept it - low-s is NOT enforced for es256 (0x01/0x02); enforcing it retroactively would reject already-anchored records.

notes: Tier ③, frozen spec inscription-tier-spec-2026-09-02. ADDITIVE: R (143 B), the 86-byte OP_RETURN, the aux fold and the 0x10 framing are unchanged; ③ only gives the existing fold a real envelope_root and adds a reveal witness.
script = <script_key(32 B x-only)> OP_CHECKSIG OP_FALSE OP_IF <protocol_tag> <content_type> <body chunk…> OP_ENDIF; every chunk but the last is exactly 520 B.

body = R(143) || s. s may be any issuer_alg (0x01/0x02/0x04/0x10) - the signature axis and the publication axis are orthogonal. envelopes.single carries s_webauthn (one chunk), envelopes.multisig carries multisig.s (two chunks, the 520-byte rule in force).
envelope_root = SHA256("BC30/envelope/v1" || len16(tag) || tag || len16(content_type) || content_type || len32(body) || body), lengths unsigned big-endian.

taproot internal key is ALWAYS the BIP-341 NUMS point (nums_internal_key), so the commit output has no key path and the envelope cannot be spent away. The script_key signs the reveal and is not the internal key.
merkle_root = SHA256(0x00 || leaf_input): ③ is always a one-leaf batch, so merkle.siblings and merkle.directions are empty.
flags = 0b11 (WITNESS_PRESENT | IDENTITY_BOUND) is ③'s sole discriminator, and it holds only because the legacy unified-witness path never sets bit1.

reveal.signature is BIP-340 with NO auxiliary randomness (aux_rand absent), which is what makes this vector byte stable; commit.tx_hex spends a synthetic funding outpoint and carries no funding witness, so commit_txid is stable without inventing a signature.

bundle below is the ③ slice of a bitcert-proof-bundle/v5. The remaining v5 members are the existing top-level fields of this file: record.preimage from record_salt / doc_sha256 / subject_type / subject_ref_pubkey / issued_at / expires_at / policy_open, signers[] from issuer_pub33 + authenticator_data + client_data_json + signature_der (or the multisig section), aux.tl_entry / aux.tl_proof from tl_entries_three + tl_proof_three, aux.sl_proof from sl_proof_exclusion. bc30-leaf carries no bundle schema and does not restate them here.

negative[].error is EnvelopeError::id() for stages envelope / binding / witness / anchor; stage batch and stage bundle are checked by the verifiers (bc30-leaf has no merkle-path or schema layer to fail them in).

notes: s = 0x10 || count(1) || [ role_len(1) || role_utf8 || key_id(32) || inner_len(2 BE) || inner_sig ] x count.

strict rules: count 2..=8; at least one issuer entry; key_id globally unique; strictly ascending (role_ord, key_id) - receivers reject, never re-sort; role_len 1..=32 closed vocabulary; inner algs 0x01/0x02/0x04 only, no 0x10 nesting; inner_len exact (0x04 inner exactly 65 B); whole s <= 8192 B.
entry composition follows appendix C.1: issuer passkey + subject-consent passkey + endorser wallet.
R and m are the top-level record fields; leaf_input = SHA256("BC30/leaf/v2" || 0x01 || R || s).

notes: Hex is lowercase without 0x. Integers are u64 unix seconds; 0 = none.
Keys: priv = SHA256(seed) as the P-256 scalar; pub33 = compressed SEC1.
Signatures are RFC 6979 deterministic ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256, DER, NOT low-s normalised.
authenticator_data = SHA256(rp_id) || 0x05 || sign_count(4 BE); client_data_json is the exact signed bytes.
R/m/leaf_input/leaf_hash use subject_type 2 (pubkey) with subject_pub33.
leaf_input uses s_webauthn; leaf_input_es256_plain uses s_es256_plain.
aux_commitment = SHA256(BC30AUX2 || aux_inputs.tl_root || aux_inputs.sl_root || aux_inputs.envelope_root).
op_return_v31 = BC30 || 1f || 02 || op_return_batch_id || op_return_merkle_root || aux_commitment (86 B).
sl_proof_*: 256 siblings leaf->root; siblings[i] pairs with key bit (255-i) MSB-first; bit 0 => node(cur,sib), 1 => node(sib,cur); fold exclusion from empty_leaf.

policy is an open key-value object: required keys document_type + jurisdiction; key grammar ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; at most 16 pairs; values UTF-8 <= 256 B without control (Cc: C0, DEL, C1) or bidi-control (U+202A..=U+202E, U+2066..=U+2069) characters; whole JCS <= 2048 B.
pairs are given in arbitrary order; JCS (RFC 8785) sorts keys. Keys are ASCII-closed so UTF-16 and code-point orders agree.
policy_hash = SHA256(jcs bytes).
issuer_alg 0x04: s = 0x04 || r(32) || s(32), exactly 65 B, no length prefix, no header.
digest = SHA256(SHA256(0x18 || "Bitcoin Signed Message:\n" || varint(len(msg)) || msg)); ECDSA verifies the digest directly (no re-hash).
low-s enforced for 0x04 only: s > n/2 is rejected (normalisation is ingestion's job). Both scalars must be in [1, n-1].
key_id = SHA256(0x02 || curve_id || pubkey33) with curve_id 2 = secp256k1.
registration proof of possession is the 65-byte recoverable form header(27..=34) || r || s; the key is recovered once at registration.
signatures are RFC 6979 deterministic (libsecp256k1), already low-s.
